verdict.rationale: Retell supports 'agent versions' with create/update/publish/list/fetch operations via CLI and MCP (retell-docs-47), implying some versioning and possibly rollback via republishing an older version, but there is no documented review workflow (diffs, approvals, changelogs) or explicit rollback command/UI. missing for 10: explicit rollback mechanism, version diff/review UI, changelog or audit trail, and any independent/hands-on confirmation that version history and rollback actually work as described.
